blocks.title: Solids
blocks.text: Solids are substances which are rigid and hard and have a definite shape and a definite volume.
The atoms, ions and molecules that make up a solid are closely packed and held together by strong cohesive forces; the constituent atoms, ions or molecules of a solid cannot move at random.
